name: Ecole Marocaine des Sciences de l'Ingénieur EMSI
overview:
Presentation

EMSI, established over 39 years ago, is the largest private engineering school in Morocco. EMSI is recognized by the state, provides excellent engineering training, and has 19 campuses throughout Morocco, in Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Fez, and Tangier. 

Campus life 

EMSI has a total of 18 sites in the Kingdom of Morocco (Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Tangier, and Fez). Each of these sites has numerous classrooms, laboratories, and computing centers equipped with sophisticated, state-of-the-art teaching materials for the needs of practical work, mini-projects, projects, and scientific research. 

More information can be found here.
administrative:
1) Application dossier  

Once the IAFF office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application. All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline). 

If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet, please be patient.  

To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):  

  • The addendum to the contract.  
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier.  

2) Visa  

You will need a visa to study in Morocco. Please check the immigration office of the host country to check the visa process and fees.  

Students in France can use this website as well: https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/      

3) Insurance  

You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay. Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more information depending on the wanted coverage.  

Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake…) in your host country for French citizens only: https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/ public / login.html
accomodation: EMSI does not provide accommodation, but the partner can help you find some nice areas to live in.
courses:
30 ECTS per semester 

60 ECTS a year 

Students will follow semester 3 and 4 as part of the engineering cycle at EMSI. The curriculum is in French. 

You can choose 3 different specializations in semester 4. Semester 3 is common for everyone. 

  • IIR (Ingéniérie Informatique et Réseaux) 
  • IASD (Intelligence Artificielle et Science des Données) 
  • CIR (Cybersécurité et Infrastructure des Réseaux) 

More details about the courses for each semester can be found here.

The course list is given to you for information. It can change from year to year. If a course is not available when you arrive, EPITECH cannot be held responsible for it.
